parameters.content:
## Claude - Call With Skills (Batch Mode)

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/claude-call-with-skills

**Description:** Appel Claude avec Skills API via Batch Processing.
Les requêtes sont soumises de manière asynchrone pour éviter les timeouts.

**InputSchema:**
```json
{
  "required": ["api_key", "messages", "container", "callback_url"],
  "properties": {
    "api_key": { "type": "string" },
    "model": { "type": "string", "default": "claude-sonnet-4-20250514" },
    "betas": { "type": "array", "default": ["code-execution-2025-08-25", "skills-2025-10-02"] },
    "system": { "type": "string" },
    "messages": { "type": "array" },
    "max_tokens": { "type": "integer", "default": 16000 },
    "container": { "skills": [...] },
    "callback_url": { "type": "string", "description": "URL pour recevoir les résultats" },
    "correlation_id": { "type": "string", "description": "ID unique (auto-généré si absent)" },
    "metadata": { "type": "object" }
  }
}
```

**Réponse immédiate (202):**
```json
{
  "status": "processing",
  "batch_id": "msgbatch_xxx",
  "correlation_id": "...",
  "message": "Batch submitted. Results will be sent to callback_url."
}
```

**Callback (quand terminé):**
Les résultats complets avec fichiers sont envoyés à callback_url.

**Note:** Utilise le Batch API (50% moins cher, pas de timeout)
